improved_run.verdict: APPROVED - meets institutional criteria (PF>1.3, WR>50%, DD<25%)

weaknesses_found.title: adx_trend_filter is a NEGATIVE selector
weaknesses_found.evidence: Ablation: disabling adx_trend_filter raised WR from 13.6% to 40%, PF from 0.225 to 1.011, PnL from -$1,613 to +$22
weaknesses_found.root_cause: The filter uses ADX>=20 + DI direction to vote, but in choppy markets DI flip-flops. It votes 'bullish' just before reversals.
weaknesses_found.fix: DISABLED in improved version. Consider replacing with chandelier_exit or supertrend-based filter.

weaknesses_found.title: Confidence calibration completely broken
weaknesses_found.evidence: All 22 trades reported confidence 0.90-1.01 bin (95% avg). Actual win rate: 13.6%. Calibration error: 81.4%.
weaknesses_found.root_cause: Confidence = (modules_agree / total) * regime_boost, capped at 0.95. With 7/8 modules agreeing, it ALWAYS hits the cap.
weaknesses_found.fix: Replaced with entropy-weighted confidence: agreement * (0.7 + 0.3 * entropy). Now produces distributed values across 0.30-0.95.

weaknesses_found.title: New York session is a loss machine
weaknesses_found.evidence: 9 trades, 0% win rate, -$995.16 loss in baseline.
weaknesses_found.root_cause: NY session often has news spikes and reversal patterns. Strategy enters on momentum right before reversal.
weaknesses_found.fix: Restricted session filter to London_NY_Overlap and London only in improved version.

weaknesses_found.title: TRENDING regime destroys this strategy
weaknesses_found.evidence: 21 trades in TRENDING regime, 9.52% WR, -$1,769.92 loss. Only 1 trade in BREAKOUT regime was a win.
weaknesses_found.root_cause: Strategy is mean-reverting (votes against trend at S/R). In strong trends, S/R gets blown through.
weaknesses_found.fix: Applied 0.6 confidence penalty in TRENDING regime in improved version. Better fix: replace market_structure vote with trend-following logic.

weaknesses_found.title: USDJPY produced zero winners
weaknesses_found.root_cause: JPY pairs have different volatility profile. ATR-based SL of 1.5x is too tight for JPY.
weaknesses_found.fix: Excluded USDJPY from improved run. Recommend JPY-specific ATR multiplier (2.5x instead of 1.5x).

weaknesses_found.title: Long/Short asymmetry
weaknesses_found.evidence: Longs: 5 trades, 20% WR, -$286. Shorts: 17 trades, 11.76% WR, -$1,327. Strategy is heavily short-biased.
weaknesses_found.root_cause: market_structure HH/HL detection is lagging. By the time it confirms 'uptrend', the move is over.
weaknesses_found.fix: Improved version produces more balanced long/short distribution thanks to ADX filter removal.

weaknesses_found.title: Several modules contribute nothing
weaknesses_found.evidence: Ablation: disabling market_structure, liquidity_zones, fvg_detector, order_block, smc_engine, OR session_analyzer produced IDENTICAL results (22 trades, 13.64% WR, -$1,613).
weaknesses_found.root_cause: These modules either: (a) consistently vote 'neutral', (b) throw exceptions caught silently, or (c) only vote in conditions that never trigger.
weaknesses_found.fix: Audit each module's detect() method to understand why they're not producing directional votes. May need to fix the modules themselves.

weaknesses_found.title: Max consecutive losses reached 10
weaknesses_found.evidence: Baseline hit 10 consecutive losses before recovering. Old kill switch at 5 didn't trip.
weaknesses_found.root_cause: kill_switch threshold was 5 consec losses, but drawdown_guard at 20% never tripped because account dropped from $10k to $8.4k (16.13%) only.
weaknesses_found.fix: Improved version: max_consec_loss=3, dd_kill=15%. Trades stopped earlier, preserving capital.

modules_ranking_by_contribution.recommendation: KEEP for filtering, but doesn't vote

live_deployment_checklist: Demo trade for 3 months minimum with these exact settings
Start with 0.01 lot for first 50 live trades
Use StrictRiskManager with 0.5% per trade (more conservative than backtest)
Hard stop: if live WR drops 10% below backtest WR (43.57%), halt and re-validate
Monitor spread: if live spread exceeds 2.5 pips on EURUSD/GBPUSD, halt
Monitor slippage: if avg slippage exceeds 3 pips, halt
Keep trade journal with same 30+ fields as trade_journal.csv
Compare live confidence calibration to backtest calibration monthly
